games.name: Emergency Emden
games.desc:
Emergency Roleplay Simulator: Emden 

Located by the north sea in Germany, Emden is a port city that attracts both big companies and criminals alike.

🚓 Keep the city safe from crime as police officer,
🚒 fight raging fires and rescue people as firefighter,
🚑 save people's lives as a paramedic,
🚌 or drive people around the city by train or bus.

🚙 Purchase and drive a wide array of different civilian cars, ATVs and motorcycles.
🎨 Customize them and change their paint and rims; add ornaments, spoilers and underfloor lighting to make your vehicle visually appealing and unique. 

💰 Turn against the law and serve yourself on the money of the local bank; rob gas stations and parked money trucks to make your living in an illegal way...
👮 But watch your back for other traitor criminals and responding police forces!

🌟 Play in a private server and customize the map to create unique roleplaying, racing or PvP events for your friends and community.

games.name: Aeronautica
games.desc:
Train, Buy, Fly - Aeronautica is an open-world flight simulator with economy elements where the goal is entirely up to you. Earn money by completing unique jobs or flights between distant islands and continents. You can even create an airline for you and your friends to join! 

Train and earn licenses to unlock exciting new vehicles. Customize and maintain your vehicles as you work your way up from the smallest ultralights to the world’s largest airliners like the Airbus A380 Superjumbo. 

In Aeronautica you can explore:

> ✈️ 800+ unique vehicles in 10 different classes to unlock. Ranging from airliners to ultralights, and fighter jets to boats 
> 🛫 210+ airports and heliports, ranging from dirt runways to large international airports 
> 💸 Custom player-run airlines for you and your friends 
> 📈 Fluctuating player-driven markets where you can sell your acquired aircraft and parts 
> 🎨 Customizable liveries and vehicles
> ⛈️ Dynamic weather
